general_protocol: General Cross-Project Research Protocol v0.7.4 FINAL
question: How do carrier persistence, splitting/mixing, apparent reconvergence, and lineage identifiability change across repeated same-spectrum carrier transformations as transformation strength, spectral crowding, and numerical/measurement-like perturbation magnitude vary?

native_synthetic_construction.correspondence: squared absolute carrier overlap |V_parent.T @ V_child|^2 after eigenvalue-order alignment
native_synthetic_construction.reason: Hold scalar spectrum fixed while transforming carrier geometry so lineage diagnostics cannot be credited to spectral change alone.

perturbation_rule.construction: For each generation operator independently, add a seeded symmetric Gaussian perturbation scaled to the declared relative Frobenius magnitude times the unperturbed operator Frobenius norm; diagonalize the perturbed symmetric operator and order carriers by ascending eigenvalue.
perturbation_rule.zero_perturbation_rule: At epsilon=0 the exact unperturbed carrier bases are used without random perturbation.
perturbation_rule.bounds: For each correspondence entry, retain the minimum and maximum across all frozen seeds as a descriptive perturbation envelope. These are not confidence intervals.

limit_outputs: interval-resolved lineage nonidentifiability under the frozen perturbation envelope
loss of agreement between sequential normalized flow and direct end-to-end carrier correspondence

reconvergence_check.purpose: Test whether sequential row-normalized relative-flow propagation preserves the same information as direct carrier comparison when the final exact basis returns to the initial basis.
reconvergence_check.comparison_metric: L1 distance between the final descendant-weight vector and the direct start-parent row of the end-to-end correspondence
reconvergence_check.interpretation_firewall: A discrepancy is information about the descriptive-flow reduction. It is not physical lineage loss if the direct carrier relation reconverges.

subspace_check.metric: minimum singular value of V_parent_sector.T @ V_child_sector
subspace_check.purpose: Distinguish individual-carrier ambiguity from preservation of the two-dimensional crowded subspace.

known_context_before_execution: NSD hierarchical and feedback P0-D work already reviewed in the broader program
claim_ceiling: P0-D synthetic lineage Function/Limit mapping only. The map may qualify or falsify descriptive lineage reductions but cannot establish physical substrate inheritance or a universal cross-scale lineage rule.
